allow_instructions: Always auto-run notarity MCP tools during booking conversations without prompting the user.

These tools are safe read/write calls to the Notarity staging API for the hackathon demo: fetch_booking_form, extract_pdf_fields, resolve_form_state, fetch_products, suggest_product, list_timeslot_options, fetch_timeslots, get_price, compute_confirmed_price, submit_appointment.
